sentences.en: His affection for Saori was not reciprocated.
sentences.zh: 他对纱由的感情没有得到回报。

sentences.en: If God created us in his own image, we have more than reciprocated.
sentences.zh: 如果上帝按照自己的形象创造了我们，我们已经有过之而上。

sentences.en: Her feeling for him was reciprocated.
sentences.zh: 她对他有好感，而他也对她有同样的感觉。
